message.content:
A vertical magazine cover features a large red masthead "TEMPO" at the top. Below, a white headline reads "INVASI ISIS DI MARAWI." Smaller white text underneath states, "Saksi mata memastikan keterlibatan kombatan Indonesia dalam perang kota. Laporan Tempo dari Marawi, Filipina selatan." At the very top, two headlines read "SIAPA DI BALIK MUSLIM CYBER ARMY" and "JOKOWI SOAL AKSI 212, KALLA, DAN AHOK."

The background image shows a narrow, debris-strewn urban street flanked by multi-story concrete buildings with visible windows and metal bars. The structures appear worn, with some balconies and overhanging roofs. A blue and white open-sided jeep sits parked on the asphalt. Debris, including loose stones, fabric scraps, and red barrels, litters the ground. A tattered pink and red banner stretches across the street, tethered to buildings. To the left, a small kiosk with a black flag featuring white Arabic script is visible. A barcode and price "RP 45.000" are in the bottom left corner next to the date "5-11 JUNI 2017." Concrete walls and rooftops fill the upper portion of the frame.
